name: What is a final quality walkthrough in construction?
description: A final quality walkthrough is an inspection with the client before project completion to ensure all work meets standards and expectations.

mainEntity.name: What is a final quality walkthrough in construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: A final quality walkthrough is a comprehensive inspection of a construction project conducted with the client before project completion. Its purpose is to ensure all work meets the agreed-upon standards, specifications, and client expectations. This includes checking for proper installation, functionality of systems, aesthetic finishes, and addressing any last-minute concerns or deficiencies. It's a critical step to guarantee client satisfaction and project readiness.
